marc:datafield.marc:subfield: LAIN daRI yaNg LAIN. EPISOD 9. SIRI 8.

Contains 3 segments: SEGMENT 1 This week's showcase highlights the health benefits of hot spring water flowing from rock crevices, which is said to cure various illnesses, in addition to its stunning natural beauty. SEGMENT 2 A fascinating story about a coconut tree climber whose dangerous stunts resemble those of Tarzan in a village located within the Dungun district of Terengganu. SEGMENT 3 A unique pricing calculation where food items are counted in the hundreds for every RM1. This pricing gimmick is bound to surprise first-time customers dining here.
